_note: Grade 10 (SSC-II) chapter structure, from the board's own Tables of Specification in the
2025 SSC-II Assessment Frameworks (content/fbise/pdf/ssc2/, gitignored). Same philosophy as
chapters.json for grade 9: a chapter is a ToS content area, mapped to SLO domains or
CODE-RANGE strings so every outcome lands in exactly one chapter deterministically.
share IS THE BOARD'S NUMBER where the ToS states it per content area (phy, bio, cs, pst,
math domains). Where a ToS column scan was ambiguous (chem) or domains had to be split into
study-sized chapters (math, pst sub-domains), the share is the ToS group total distributed
by outcome count, rounded; the method is honest weighting, not board gospel per chapter.
eng/urd/isl shares are null pending a readable SSC-II ToS for them (Urdu-typeset PDFs).
MARKS ARE NOT PAPER MARKS: ToS tables count both branches of either/or questions, so they
foot above the real paper total. Treat marks as relative weight, trust share.
This file is also the grade-10 chapter CATALOG: titles, urduTitle and blurbs live here
(grade 9's live in packages/core content.ts; grade 10 is database-first by design, the
bundled catalog stays grade 9). Chapter ids become <subject>-10-<number>.
source: ModelPaper/2025/Assessment Frameworks/SSC-II/*, Table of Specification pages

chapters.title: Heat and Thermodynamics
chapters.blurb: Heat capacity, modes of heat transfer, thermal expansion and changes of state. Almost one mark in five on your paper starts here.

chapters.title: Waves and Sound
chapters.blurb: Wave behaviour, reflection, refraction and diffraction, then sound: how it travels, its speed, loudness and quality.

chapters.title: Optics
chapters.blurb: Mirrors, lenses, refraction and total internal reflection, image formation and the optical instruments built on them.

chapters.title: Electrostatics
chapters.blurb: Charge, electric fields, capacitors and lightning: electricity at rest and what it does.

chapters.title: Current Electricity and Circuits
chapters.blurb: Current, voltage, resistance, Ohm's law, series and parallel circuits, electrical power and safe use of electricity.

chapters.title: Basic Electronics
chapters.blurb: Digital and analogue electronics, Boolean logic and the logic gates every year's paper asks about.

chapters.title: Electromagnetism
chapters.blurb: Electromagnetic induction, generators, motors, transformers and electromagnetic waves.

chapters.title: Nuclear Physics
chapters.blurb: The atom's nucleus, radioactivity, half-life, fission and fusion, and the uses and dangers of radiation.

chapters.title: States of Matter
chapters.blurb: Changes of state, heating and cooling curves, and the kinetic particle theory behind them.

chapters.title: Solutions and Concentration
chapters.blurb: Concentration in grams and moles per cubic decimetre, composition by mass and percentage purity.

chapters.title: Electrochemistry
chapters.blurb: Electrolytic and voltaic cells, electrode reactions and ionic half-equations. One of the heaviest chapters on the paper.

chapters.title: Rates of Reaction
chapters.blurb: Collision theory and everything that speeds a reaction up or slows it down.

chapters.title: Salts
chapters.blurb: How salts form, their solubility rules and how to prepare them.

chapters.title: Chemistry of Nitrogen and Sulphur
chapters.blurb: Oxides of nitrogen, the Haber process, sulfur dioxide and sulfuric acid.

chapters.title: Metals
chapters.blurb: General properties of metals, amphoteric oxides and the reactivity behind extraction.

chapters.title: Hydrocarbons and Fuels
chapters.blurb: Alkanes, alkenes and alkynes, fossil fuels and the fractions of petroleum.

chapters.title: Alcohols and Carboxylic Acids
chapters.blurb: The two organic families the board examines hardest: their preparation, reactions and everyday roles.

chapters.title: Polymers and Biochemistry
chapters.blurb: Plastics and their environmental cost, then the molecules of life: carbohydrates, proteins, fats and vitamins.

chapters.title: Digestive System
chapters.blurb: Ingestion to assimilation: the alimentary canal, enzymes, the villus and the diseases of digestion.

chapters.title: Circulatory System
chapters.blurb: Blood, its cells, the heart's structure and the heart diseases examiners return to every year.

chapters.title: Urinary System
chapters.blurb: Kidneys, nephrons, urine formation, osmoregulation and kidney failure.

chapters.title: Respiratory System
chapters.blurb: The air passageway, the mechanism of breathing and the diseases that attack it.

chapters.title: Coordination and Control
chapters.blurb: Nervous system, neurons, synapses, reflexes and the endocrine glands. The heaviest chapter of your year.

chapters.title: Reproduction
chapters.blurb: Asexual and sexual reproduction, gametogenesis and fertilization.

chapters.title: Inheritance
chapters.blurb: Chromosomes, genotype and phenotype, and Mendel's laws through monohybrid and dihybrid crosses.

chapters.title: Diseases
chapters.blurb: Pathogens, infectious and non-infectious disease, diabetes, cancer and the lessons of Covid-19.

chapters.title: Immunity
chapters.blurb: The immune system, blood clotting, vaccines and allergies.

chapters.title: Biotechnology
chapters.blurb: Food, medical and marine biotechnology, genetic editing and bioremediation.

chapters.title: Biostatistics and Data Handling
chapters.blurb: Mean, median and mode for biological data, and the charts that present them.

chapters.title: Complex Numbers
chapters.blurb: The number i, operations on complex numbers, conjugates, modulus and their geometric meaning.

chapters.title: Quadratic Equations and Inequalities
chapters.blurb: Solving quadratics, the discriminant, roots and coefficients, and quadratic inequalities.

chapters.title: Matrices and Determinants
chapters.blurb: Matrix operations, determinants, inverses and solving simultaneous equations with them.

chapters.title: Functions and Graphs
chapters.blurb: Types of functions, composition, inverses, absolute value and their graphs.

chapters.title: Algebraic Fractions and Inequalities
chapters.blurb: Rational expressions, algebraic fractions and regions bounded by linear inequalities.

chapters.title: Equations and Graph Sketching
chapters.blurb: Equations reducible to quadratics, exponential growth and decay, gradients and sketching non-linear graphs.

chapters.title: Vectors in a Plane
chapters.blurb: Vectors as directed segments, position vectors, magnitude, addition and geometric problems.

chapters.title: Further Trigonometry
chapters.blurb: Sine and cosine beyond acute angles, the laws of sines and cosines, and 3D problems.

chapters.title: Chords and Arcs of a Circle
chapters.blurb: The circle theorems on chords and arcs, and the problems the board builds on them.

chapters.title: Tangents and Angles of a Circle
chapters.blurb: Tangent properties and angle theorems in circles.

chapters.title: Practical Geometry of Circles
chapters.blurb: Constructing circles and tangents with ruler and compasses, the way the paper asks for them.

chapters.title: Statistics
chapters.blurb: Cumulative frequency, quartiles, box plots, scatter diagrams, correlation and standard deviation.

chapters.title: Probability of Combined Events
chapters.blurb: The addition and multiplication laws of probability for combined events.

chapters.title: Computer Systems
chapters.blurb: System software, hardware and the tools that hold a computer together. The heaviest chapter of your paper.

chapters.title: Computational Thinking and Algorithms
chapters.blurb: Common algorithms, abstraction and building modular solutions.

chapters.title: Programming Fundamentals
chapters.blurb: Front-end and back-end, advanced programming techniques and implementing real algorithms.

chapters.title: Data and Analysis
chapters.blurb: The scope, types and stages of data analysis: the second-heaviest chapter on the paper.

chapters.title: Applications of Computer Science
chapters.blurb: Where computing meets the world, including AI and its social effects.

chapters.title: Impacts of Computing
chapters.blurb: Safe and responsible use of technology and strategies against its harms.

chapters.title: Digital Literacy
chapters.blurb: The digital divide and what digital citizenship demands.

chapters.title: Entrepreneurship in Computing
chapters.blurb: Communicating and publishing ideas: turning computing skills into ventures.

chapters.title: Cultural Diversity of Pakistan
chapters.blurb: Languages, folklore, mystical orders and the cultural elements that shape Pakistani society.

chapters.title: Sports and Leisure in Society
chapters.blurb: Why leisure and sports matter to a society, in the board's own framing.

chapters.title: Constitutional Development
chapters.blurb: From the Objectives Resolution through the constitutions of 1956, 1962 and 1973. The heaviest chapter of the paper.

chapters.title: Citizenship and Rule of Law
chapters.blurb: Rule of law, citizenship, free press and what it means to be a digital citizen.

chapters.title: Pakistan's Foreign Policy
chapters.blurb: The aims of foreign policy and Pakistan's geo-political position.

chapters.title: Pakistan and International Affairs
chapters.blurb: The United Nations, Pakistan's relations with its neighbours and the wider world.

chapters.title: Oral Communication Skills
chapters.blurb: Listening and speaking for different purposes. Judged in class, not on the annual paper, but the base of every other skill.

chapters.title: Reading and Critical Thinking
chapters.blurb: Reading strategies, informational texts, poetry and precis: the comprehension half of your paper.

chapters.title: Vocabulary and Grammar
chapters.blurb: Tenses, conjunctions and the grammar and vocabulary questions of Section A.

chapters.title: Writing
chapters.blurb: Narrative and informative writing, and the precis skills the paper rewards.

chapters.blurb: مضمون نویسی، خط و درخواست، تلخیص اور ترجمہ: پرچے کا سب سے وزنی حصہ۔
